# Appitools

> Appitools is an Apache-2.0 Go engine that compiles a JSON schema into a
> production multi-tenant REST + GraphQL + OpenAPI server at boot. One
> static binary (~24 MB RSS idle) on your own server, PostgreSQL with
> schema-per-tenant isolation, JWT + RBAC deny-by-default, declarative
> validation, SSE change streams. You don't write handlers, models, or
> migrations — you write a ~20-line schema file.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, verified quick start (Docker image →
  first API call in 4 commands), feature list, honest comparison table
  and known limits
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): for AI agents — exact build/test commands, repo
  conventions and boundaries, plus the integration guide: complete
  verified schema syntax (field types, validation rules, RBAC) and exact
  API syntax (filters, sort, keyset pagination, GraphQL) including what
  does NOT exist
- [Deploy guide](docs/DEPLOY.md): laptop quickstart and production VPS
  setup (Caddy, automatic TLS, tenant subdomains, CORS workaround)
- [Public benchmark](context-docs/BENCHMARK_PUBLIC.md): full methodology
  vs NestJS — 2000 RPS sustained, p50 1.58 ms, statistical treatment,
  every limitation declared, raw per-run data

## Examples

- [Quickstart schema](examples/quickstart/schema.json): the canonical
  todo-api schema the Docker image boots with — copy this to start
